title: cuDNN: Efficient Primitives for Deep Learning
description: cuDNN provides GPU-optimized implementations of convolutions, matrix multiplications, activation functions, normalization layers, and RNNs. It exposes an API that all major frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, MXNet) call internally. The FFT-based and Winograd convolution algorithms in cuDNN enabled the first practical deep CNN training on GPUs.
authors: Chetlur, Woolley, Vandermersch, Cohen, Tran, Catanzaro, Shelhamer (NVIDIA)
